title: Is it French you are talking
html_source: Ironically the milkwoman, who is symbolically associated with Irish culture in the mind of Stephen, has no knowledge of her country’s native language. As well, that an Englishman visiting the country as a tourist should instruct the native inhabitants in the necessity of reviving their cultural heritage, and be mistaken for a native of the west, is also entirely ironic.
